decisions.reason: It is very close to the firm's existing dairy know-how and the award shown on the website is a strong early signal that the firm can successfully learn from and commercialise this product.
This cheese variant builds directly on the firm's established cheese capabilities and its home-page prominence suggests enough initial importance and feedback to justify continued support.
A semi-hard cheese wheel fits the firm's narrow but deep dairy specialisation, so even without strong extra signals it is close enough to existing knowledge to remain worth refining.
Spicy cheese is an incremental extension of the firm's established cheese range, making it easy to absorb market feedback and improve within existing production and sales routines.
The mild creamy soft cheese clearly extends the current offer in a related way, so despite limited evidence beyond launch the firm is likely to keep it as a learnable adjacent product.

Washed-rind soft cheese is still related to the firm's core cheese competence, but as a more specific product with weaker visible traction it carries the highest, though still below-even, risk of withdrawal.
